en.headline: Customs smash cannabis oil lab and distribution centre, seize HK$1.3 m drugs
en.dek: A 46-year-old Indonesian man was arrested in Prince Edward and charged with manufacturing and trafficking dangerous drugs after raids on industrial units in Kowloon Bay and Yau Tong.
body: Hong Kong Customs on Tuesday arrested a 46-year-old Indonesian man holding a recognisance form after discovering a suspected cannabis oil manufacturing workshop and a separate distribution centre in industrial buildings.

Officers first detained the man in Prince Edward and then took him to a unit in Kowloon Bay, where they seized about 1.9 kg of suspected cannabis oil, 2.4 kg of suspected cannabis gummies and packaging and manufacturing tools including metal pots, syringes, electronic scales and induction cookers. A further search at a Yau Tong industrial unit yielded about 2,200 suspected cannabis oil vape cartridges and a small quantity of additional gummies.

The total estimated street value of the drugs is about HK$1.3 million. Customs said the man appeared to have operated a one-man production and distribution chain, heating cannabis oil, adding fruit-flavoured essences and filling cartridges for supply in Kowloon and the New Territories. He faces one count of manufacturing a dangerous drug and two counts of trafficking and is due to appear in West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday.

zh.headline: 海關搗破大麻油製毒工場及分銷中心 檢130萬元毒品拘一男
zh.dek: 46歲持行街紙印尼籍男子在太子被捕，九龍灣及油塘工廈單位檢獲約1.9公斤懷疑大麻油、2.4公斤軟糖及2,200支煙彈，明日提堂。
body: 香港海關周二在太子拘捕一名46歲持行街紙的印尼籍無業男子，其後在九龍灣及油塘兩個工廈單位搗破懷疑大麻油製毒工場及毒品分銷中心。
關員押解疑犯到九龍灣單位搜查，檢獲約1.9公斤懷疑大麻油、約2.4公斤懷疑大麻軟糖，以及金屬煲、針筒、電子磅、電磁爐等製毒及包裝工具；其後在油塘單位再檢約2,200支懷疑大麻油煙彈及少量軟糖。毒品估計市值合共約130萬元。
海關表示，疑犯疑獨自進行製毒、包裝、儲存及分銷，過程中加入水果香味香油以吸引年輕人。男子已被控一項製造危險藥物罪及兩項販運危險藥物罪，明日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
